{
  "causa_probabile": "Motor cooling fan clogged with cardboard dust",
  "pagina_manuale": 3,
  "citazione": "A slow rise in motor temperature with nearly stable current indicates insufficient cooling (fan or grille clogged with cardboard dust) or overload due to speed.",
  "confidenza": 0.85,
  "azione_raccomandata": "Reduce conveyor speed by 30-40% immediately to lower thermal load. Schedule fan cleaning at the next planned stop (about 20 minutes).",
  "codice_azione": "riduci_velocita",
  "ricambi": ["Motor fan – code NT4-V01"]
}

{
  "causa_probabile": "Worn or damaged bearing in the centrifugal feed pump causing unstable flow and fill-level variations downstream",
  "pagina_manuale": 6,
  "citazione": "A damaged bearing reduces flow stability and can cause fill-level variations in filling machines downstream.",
  "confidenza": 0.7,
  "azione_raccomandata": "Stop the pump immediately, lock out/tag out, close valves, release pressure. Inspect bearings for wear or damage; replace if necessary (see manual p. 7). Check coupling alignment. Also verify impeller for debris as a secondary cause.",
  "codice_azione": "intervento_manutentivo",
  "ricambi": ["PC80-B01", "PC80-B02", "PC80-G05", "LUB-L3"]
}
{"livello_rischio": "basso", "motivazione": "Reducing speed is a safe remote action and the motor temperature is not yet at a critical danger level."}
{"livello_rischio": "alto", "motivazione": "The action involves a centrifugal pump, which contains rotating parts and pressurized fluids."}
